stemMarkdown: Pipe A can fill a tank in 15 hours and pipe B can fill it in 6 hours. If both are opened together, how many hours will it take to fill the tank? (Round to 4 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: In one hour A fills $\dfrac{1}{15}$ of the tank and B fills $\dfrac{1}{6}$, so together they fill $\dfrac{1}{15} + \dfrac{1}{6} = 0.233333$ per hour. The full tank takes $\dfrac{1}{0.233333} = 4.2857$ hours.
altSolutionMarkdown: Add rates, never times — the combined time is always less than either pipe alone.
